title: Branchyard rig spec
description:
A Branchyard rig spec: a root seat and the seats below it, joined by
`delegates_to` edges that form a tree. See docs/rigs.md.

version.description: The spec format's version; this build reads 1.

name.description:
The rig's name, and the root branch's unless `by rig run --name`
gives one.

root.description: The name of the root seat, one of `seats`.

pods.description: Groups of seats sharing startup files, by name.

seats.description: The seats, by name: the root and those below it.

Startup.description:
Files delivered to a harness as standing instructions, never written
into a worktree.

files.description:
Paths relative to the spec's directory, without `..`; a bare path
is required.

required.description:
A missing optional file is skipped; a missing required one (the
default) is an error.

Pod.description: A group of seats sharing startup files.

startup.description: Startup files for the pod's seats.

description.description: The seat's role, given to its harness and to the parent's.

pod.description: The pod whose startup files this seat also gets.

harness.description:
A harness or profile ID; a child defaults to its parent's, the
root to claude-code.

effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh, or a level from 0 to 100.

auth.description: A credential name the server resolves.

secrets.description:
Names of secrets to write into the branch's private home; needs
isolated = true here or above.

mcp.description: Stdio MCP servers, as name = "command line".

telemetry.description: `off`, or an http:// or https:// OTLP collector endpoint.

isolated.description: Run in a home private to the branch; inherited by the seats below.

check.description:
The check a branch must pass to integrate: a command line, or its
words.

delegates_to.description: The seats this seat may spawn.

escalates_to.description: Ancestor seats, besides its parent, this seat may escalate to.

instances.description: How many of this seat may run at once; 1 by default.

bindings.description: Scratch areas, as NAME:read_only or NAME:exclusive_write.

start.description: Only on_demand: the root starts alone and fills seats as it spawns.

restore_policy.description: Only resume_if_possible: a send resumes the branch's session.

Budget.description: Limits for one branch in this seat.

Policy.description: How permission requests are answered. A child seat may set only deny.

default.description: Requests no rule decides: allow, deny (the default) or ask.

deny.description: Tool names, or prefixes ending in *, denied outright.

allow.description: Tool names, or prefixes ending in *, allowed after deny.

delegation_commands.description: Allow the harness's own `by` delegation commands.
